test_title: PYST 38: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "is."
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The blank can be filled with** "is" **to create a grammatically correct and meaningful sentence. 
 
• In this sentence,** "is"** serves as the linking verb connecting the subject (**"The challenge"**) to the complement (**"a futile exercise in turning back the clock"**).
 
• This usage helps convey the idea that the challenge is being described as a futile exercise.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.

 ​

Correct paragraph: 

The challenge in Madras high court to the Emergency-era shifting of education from state list to concurrent list **is**__ a futile exercise in turning back the clock. Forty-six years have passed ______ (2) ______ the 42 Constitution Amendment Act. In this period, the education sector has seen far too many changes, and most can’t be ______ (3) ______ . For instance, a common national medical test now allows students the ease of appearing for just one examination instead of multiple ones conducted by each state. States still enjoy ______ (4) ______ to operate their own universities, schools and education syllabus..........

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Have: **the use of **"have"** emphasizes the ongoing nature of the challenge not as a futile exercise, indicating that it discontinues to be so.
 
• **Were, Had: **indicates a past status.
